title: Jimma Coffee and Honey Beef
localName: ጅማ ቡና ሥጋ — Jimma Buna Siga
community: Jimma — the great coffee trading city of western Ethiopia
author: Chef Haile
desc: Jimma Coffee-Braised Beef — beef slow-braised with brewed Jimma coffee, honey, berbere, and onion. The Jimma cooking innovation that uses coffee as a braising liquid — the coffee provides depth, acidity, and the distinctive Jimma coffee character.
longDesc: Jimma, the great coffee trading city, has developed a cooking tradition that incorporates coffee as a cooking liquid — the braising of beef in strong coffee is a uniquely Jimma culinary innovation.
steps: Add kibbeh and berbere. Fry 3 minutes.
The coffee evaporates into the sauce — rich, deep, complex.
chefTips: Strong coffee is essential — weak coffee provides nothing.
The coffee reduces into the sauce creating an extraordinary depth.
cookingScience: Coffee contains chlorogenic acids, melanoidins, and hundreds of aromatic compounds — when used as a braising liquid, these compounds concentrate into the sauce. The chlorogenic acids act as natural tenderisers (mild acidity), while the melanoidins add deep brown colour.
sustainabilityTips: Jimma forest-grown arabica — supporting the coffee-forest ecosystem.
culturalNote: Jimma coffee-braised beef is the culinary statement of a city that has traded coffee for centuries — the ingredient that Jimma is most famous for, applied to its most valued protein. The result is uniquely Jimma.
